behavior: `NumberField.ScrubAreaCursor` renders its element in a portal element in `<body>`: an element with `data-vase-ui-portal` and `display: contents`. A style that is scoped to the portal elements, as the style of a popup can be, thus reaches the cursor. The portal element makes no box, so the layout of `<body>` does not change during a scrub. Base UI renders the element of the cursor directly in `<body>`, outside each portal element.
